# Invitation email

Dear ${m://FirstName},

I'm Balazs Aczel, and I lead the Metascience Lab at Eotvos Lorand University in Budapest, Hungary.

My colleagues and I are preparing a policy report on how much independence AI should have in scientific research. It would be really helpful for us if you could share your views on how AI is changing research in your field and what it might mean for your own work.

Would you be willing to share your views by completing a short survey? It takes less than 5 minutes, and we welcome responses from researchers across all disciplines, regardless of their experience with AI.

Follow this link to the Survey:
${l://SurveyLink?d=Take the survey}

Or copy and paste the URL below into your internet browser:
${l://SurveyURL}

Thank you in advance for your time and contribution!

Best regards,
Prof. Balazs Aczel, Dsc, PhD
Eotvos Lorand University, Hungary
Faculty of Education and Psychology
Budapest, Kazinczy u. 23-27., H-1075 Hungary
Tel.: +36 1 461 4500/3464


contact: decisionlab@ppk.elte.hu

You can independently verify this invitation on our university’s website, where we have published information about the study: https://metasciencelab.elte.hu/our-projects/

This invitation was sent through our university’s Qualtrics survey platform. You can verify our institutional affiliation through the ELTE Faculty of Education and Psychology website.

Disclaimer: We found your email address from your ORCID profile. Ethical approval 0602/2026 was issued by the Research Ethics Committee of the Faculty of Education and Psychology of Eötvös Loránd University, Hungary.

If you don't want to be contacted for our later studies, you can unsubscribe here:
${l://OptOutLink?d=Click here to unsubscribe}
